name: Cleopatra II (Alexandria)
alt: Cleopatra II sole ruler of Alexandria

predecessors.name: Ptolemaic Kingdom
predecessors.text: Alexandria, from which Cleopatra II driven out at the end of 131 BC

successors.name: Ptolemaic Kingdom
successors.text: Alexandria, taken by Ptolemy VIII in 127 BC ('Cleopatra II being forced to flee to Syria')

ledger.x: 131 BCE: Alexandria passes from Ptolemy VIII to his sister-queen.
131 BCE: the civil war's fighting over Alexandria; the bibliography dates it 'entre 132 et 124 av.
127 BCE: 'In 127 BC, he took over Alexandria, Cleopatra II being forced to flee to Syria.'
127 BCE: Alexandria returns to Ptolemy VIII; Cleopatra II flees to Syria.
127 BCE: the rebel regime ends; Cleopatra II 'ruled in Alexandria as sole ruler until 127 BC'.

wars.name: Ptolemaic civil war (Cleopatra II against Ptolemy VIII)
wars.outcome: Cleopatra II held Alexandria as sole ruler from the end of 131 until Ptolemy VIII took it in 127; she fled to Syria.

certainty.note: The extent of her control beyond Alexandria is not on the page.
